events.title: English colonists land at Jamestown
events.description: Settlers of the Virginia Company came ashore on a peninsula in the James River and built a fort. Despite famine and disease, Jamestown became the first permanent English settlement in America.
events.html: Settlers of the Virginia Company came ashore on a peninsula in the James River and built a fort. Despite famine and disease, Jamestown became the first permanent English settlement in America.

events.title: Henry IV of France is assassinated in Paris
events.description: François Ravaillac stabbed the king when his carriage was halted in the rue de la Ferronnerie. Henry, who had ended the Wars of Religion, was succeeded by his eight-year-old son Louis XIII.
events.html: François Ravaillac stabbed the king when his carriage was halted in the rue de la Ferronnerie. Henry, who had ended the Wars of Religion, was succeeded by his eight-year-old son Louis XIII.

events.title: Edward Jenner performs the first vaccination
events.description: Jenner inoculated eight-year-old James Phipps with cowpox and later showed the boy was immune to smallpox. Vaccination spread worldwide, and smallpox was declared eradicated in 1980.
events.html: Jenner inoculated eight-year-old James Phipps with cowpox and later showed the boy was immune to smallpox. Vaccination spread worldwide, and smallpox was declared eradicated in 1980.

events.title: David Ben-Gurion proclaims the State of Israel
events.description: As the British Mandate ended, Ben-Gurion declared Israel's independence in Tel Aviv. Neighbouring Arab states invaded the next day, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians were displaced in the war.
events.html: As the British Mandate ended, Ben-Gurion declared Israel's independence in Tel Aviv. Neighbouring Arab states invaded the next day, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians were displaced in the war.

events.title: Soviet bloc signs the Warsaw Pact
events.description: The USSR and seven Eastern European states formed a military alliance days after West Germany joined NATO. The pact lasted until 1991.
events.html: The USSR and seven Eastern European states formed a military alliance days after West Germany joined NATO. The pact lasted until 1991.

events.title: NASA launches Skylab, America's first space station
events.description: Skylab was launched on the last Saturn V flown. Damaged on ascent, it was repaired by its first crew, and three crews lived aboard for a total of 171 days.
